title: The Alchemist (Beta Branch)
description:
[quote]This mod is for the beta version of the game. Here is the public version: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3781688551[/quote]

[h2]Overview[/h2]
[list]
[*] ✨ 100+ new cards
[*] 💎 9 new relics
[*] 🧪 11 new potions
[*] 📚 7 timeline epochs
[*] 🎨 Handmade art and animation
[*] 🌍 Translated into 15 languages
[*] 🐸 You get to be a frog
[/list]

[h2]Playstyle[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Self-Poison[/b]: The Alchemist doses themselves on purpose. Some attacks deal additional damage based on your Poison and other cards listen for how often your Poison is triggered.
[*] [b]Antitoxin[/b]: A reserve that absorbs the damage your Poison would deal to you. It is reduced by 1 at the start of your turn.
[*] [b]Mix[/b]: These are tokens you can create in combat that are similar to potions. The basic Mixes are Bursting (damage), Syrupy (Block) and Zesty (draw); the special Mixes are Fuming (Weak and Vulnerable), Tainted (extra damage from Attacks) and Sparkling (Energy).
[*] [b]Ferment[/b]: These cards grow in potency for every turn they stay in your hand.
[*] [b]Brew[/b]: This Rest Site option allows you to procure 1 of 8 unique potions that can only be obtained this way. Due to the quality of these brews, the Merchant is willing to buy them from you for 150 Gold.
[/list]

[h2]Disclaimer[/h2]
This mod is still a work in progress and content is subject to change, but feedback is welcome! The best place to discuss the mod is official Slay the Spire Discord server in the #modding-forum.

The Alchemist has been lovingly crafted to feel like a natural addition to the game. Every card, relic, and potion has been (and will continue to be) balanced against the existing game. The same care extends to flavor and lore: this character's story is woven directly into the game's existing timeline, and observant players will find more than a few threads connecting them to the world.

changeNote:
v0.14.17

Changed

- Buffed Numb card: Dexterity now applies to the Block gained for each card discarded
- Changed All At Once and Wormwood cards: their damage is now affected by Strength, Vulnerable, Weak and Tainted
- Changed the in-combat previews of All At Once, Numb, Reclaim, Sweat It Out and Vent cards to the base game's format
- Removed the Mix count after the Bonk and Knitbone card text, since their damage and Block numbers already include it
- Reworked Fuming Mix card into an Attack: "Deal 3 (4) damage to ALL enemies. Apply 3 (4) Tainted. Exhaust."
- Updated the wording of Acrid Mix, Bestow, Brine, Croak, Digest, Distill, Eureka, Heavy Dose, Needle Point, Pour Over, Puff Up, Quench, Rerun, Resolve, Tempered, Toughen and Wormwood cards to be consistent with the base game
- Updated the wording of the Apothecary, Fresh Batch, Fresh Cutting, Miasma, Panacea and Rerun powers, the Chimera Blossom and Radiant Flask relics, the Solvent potion and the Laced keyword to be consistent with the base game

Fixed

- Apothecary power's tooltip now shows how many Mixes it adds each turn, and whether they are Mixes+
- Compound Mix now properly deals a Fuming Mix ingredient's damage to ALL enemies
- Fixed the card library shifting its cards off center when a search matched only Mixes
- Puncture now deals damage before Vulnerable is applied, matching other base game debuff attacks
- Quench now properly counts extra Antitoxin from Toadstone toward its Block
- Wormwood no longer glows when you have Poison, and its damage number now includes your Poison like the other Laced cards
